rules.sample: positives: first 20 photos of the v2 trainProbe rule (first distinct TRAIN photos of pilotOrder with a replay snapshot); negatives: the 9 reviewed TRAIN negative photos with known clean pixels (41 product tiles). TRAIN only; fixed before any raw score.
rules.raw: every anchor of every product tile, obj*cls >= .001 kept, boxes mapped to source pixels exactly as infer_tiles
rules.negatives: product _nms(.30) over clean-photo candidates; a candidate is negative only if its centre lies in the reviewed strict clean mask; elsewhere ignored
rules.targetScore: per target: best IoU of any kept anchor; best obj*cls among anchors with IoU>=.50 (and >=.30), with its obj, cls and IoU
rules.lossStage: at conf .30 for targets missed by the saved final product output: localization (no kept anchor IoU>=.50) | score (IoU>=.50 anchor exists, best score <.30) | NMS (>=.30 anchor with IoU>=.50 exists but none survives product _nms .30) | filter (survives NMS, absent from final product boxes)
rules.discrimination: AUC(target best score @IoU>=.50, 0 if none, vs negative candidate scores); localization capacity = share of targets with a kept anchor IoU>=.50. PRESERVED iff AUC_fix300 >= AUC_step0 - .05 AND capacity_fix300 >= capacity_step0 - .05
rules.calibration: same for both models, TRAIN only: smallest t in GRID with mean negative candidates per negative photo (score>=t) <= 1.0 (the frozen CDC gate limit); none -> .30. No per-photo thresholds, no score normalisation.
rules.dev: only if PRESERVED: Scope B + product-valid controls through the unchanged v2 chain at each model's frozen t; IoU .50 primary, .30 separate; the .30 confidence results stay as recorded; no re-tuning after seeing development results
